# Digital Health Guide

> A practical handbook of best practices for delivering digital services in health and social care organizations, published in fifteen locales.

The book is the source of truth; every page is plain prerendered HTML. Each topic is also Markdown in the repository.

## Site

- [Home](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/): redirects to the en-gb edition
- [Sitemap](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/sitemap.xml)
- [Search index](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/search-index.json)
- [Glossary](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/glossary/)
- [Subject index](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/subject-index/)
- [Style guide](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/style-guide/)
- [Specification](https://digital-health-guide.github.io/spec/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/digital-health-guide/digital-health-guide)
